cases.title: The learner stops after a try that moved the layer: recorded partial, plain words, no method or numbers

rubric.reason: Turn 4's record_lesson saves result "partial" after a check that ran, with demo_used false (none ran). The summary ("First try put the pivot in the right place, but the layer moved with it…") has no numbers, method, motive or names, and the mentor says "I've noted that for next time."

Every name and fact traces to tool output: Door and its places (center now, middle-left wanted) from anchor_snapshot, Needle from watch_offer, and "moved with it, to the right" from anchor_check item2.direction "right" and the moved_with_pivot hint. Anchor Point and Position are the real properties.

In Turn 4, record_lesson stored result "partial" with demo_used false, which is accurate because no demo ran. The summary describes only the work ("Put the pivot in the right place on the first try, but the layer moved along with it") with no numbers, method, motive or names. The mentor then told the learner "I've saved that for next time."

Every name the mentor used is backed by a tool result: Door, Needle (watch_offer), Anchor Point, Position, the pivot at Door's center (place_now), and Door moved to the right (anchor_check direction "right"); the middle of its left edge is the learner's own choice.

Turn 4's record_lesson call saves result "partial" after a real check, with demo_used false (truthful, since no demo ran); its summary describes only the work, with no numbers, method, motive or layer name, and the mentor tells the learner "I've noted that for next time."
